title: Zombie Girls
description: Add a female model to the 3 zombie variants
body:
This resource pack replaces the default Zombie, Husk, and Drowned with custom female-style versions while preserving their iconic and menacing presence. Featuring redesigned 3D models, updated textures, and a unique look for each variant, it blends naturally into Minecraft's vanilla aesthetic.

Requirements
This resource pack requires Custom Entity Models (CEM) support. To ensure the custom 3D models and textures work correctly, you can use:

A compatible version of OptiFine.

(Recommended) The Entity Texture Features (ETF) and Entity Model Features (EMF) mods for better performance on modern mod loaders like Fabric or Forge.
